data.name: Baseel
data.gender_notes: Baseel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘basalah’ which means ‘to ride’ or ‘to travel’. This name is often given to children who are expected to embark on a journey of life filled with wisdom, knowledge, and adventure. The name Baseel carries the meaning “Rider, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baseel usually hope their child will grow to embody rider, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing a spiritual journey towards wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Baseel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rider, Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baseel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: بسیل
